project.name: Lil Magnet Memories (test site)
project.description: Import for https://test.lilmagnetmemories.com — verifies main UI (landing, upload, static pages, catalog, nav). Run Playwright with TEST_BASE_URL=https://test.lilmagnetmemories.com. Suite: tests/e2e/scenarios/site-components.spec.ts

testPlans.name: Site presence – test.lilmagnetmemories.com
testPlans.description: Loads the live test site and asserts hero, How It Works, Shop Our Products, reviews, photo upload form, About/Contact/FAQ, custom products page, and navigation. Playwright: site-components.spec.ts (suite id: site-components).

testCases.name: Landing page shows main sections and branding
testCases.description: Title contains Lil Magnet Memories; hero heading; How It Works (4 steps); Shop Our Products; logo alt; What Our Customers Say; optional Start/Create Magnets CTA if market event UI is shown.

testCases.name: Photo upload page shows form shell
testCases.description: Photo Upload Form heading; delivery/pickup subtitle; Your Information; First Name field visible.

testCases.name: About, Contact, and FAQ pages load
testCases.description: /about — About Li'l Magnet Memories; /contact-us — Contact Us; /faq — Frequently Asked Questions and intro copy.

testCases.name: Custom products catalog page loads
testCases.description: /products/custom shows Custom Photo Magnets title and subtitle.

testCases.name: Header brand and navigation entry
testCases.description: Toolbar shows Li'l Magnet Memories (header-title-clickable); drawer menu shows Navigation and Home (visible on wide screens or after opening Menu on small).
